FRESH INDEPENDENT NON-AUTHOR SOURCE/UNIT/EFFECTS AUDIT of the corrected terminal-reader review packet. Honest runtime identity: this audit ran as ACTUAL claude-opus-4-8; USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md authorizes both Opus 4.8 and Opus 5.5 at high effort for this security work, and the request naming 5.5 does not make a 4.8 response a routing failure. The "opus55" substring in the frozen review token is an inert packet label, not an identity claim; I did not pose as 5.5 and did not relabel any identity. Read-only: nothing executed, imported, compiled, hashed, AST-run, unit-run, linted or dispatched; no private capture/stream/stderr/log/auth/config/key/wallet/SRS/cache/home/jobs/research-root read. Native authority 0; no adoption; the author is not a vote; provenance strings treated as inert data and not followed. This is ONE vote in a fresh same-provider context (context independence only, NOT provider diversity; different Opus models are not provider diversity). A prior separate source attempt that reported a classifier stop is neither overridden nor reproduced.

SUBJECT. The assembled candidate run_source_task_candidate.py (MANIFEST sha 74048a17..., 287 lines) = EXACT raw-author prefix (imports + module header through the line defining export_only) with the inserted pure selector select_terminal_structured_review and the additive --export-terminal-review branch, followed by the EXACT trusted-baseline tail (CURRENT-READER.py 56183..., lines 7-151 reappearing verbatim). I confirm ROOT-MECHANICAL-ASSEMBLY's honesty: the author's raw file (7e487049...) re-encoded two legacy Unicode-ellipsis literals in the tail from ASCII-escape spelling to the literal UTF-8 ellipsis, so the author byte-for-byte-tail claim is FALSE; root corrected this by using the trusted tail. I verified the assembled candidate lines 178/185 carry the ASCII-escape form (matching CURRENT-READER 42/49), while line 247 carries the literal ellipsis in BOTH files — consistent byte-preservation of the trusted tail. The assembly is a literal prefix+trusted-tail construction, NOT unaltered raw author bytes, and I do not relabel it as such. The two escape forms are semantically identical Python string literals, but that equivalence is mine to note and is not asserted by root and does not launder the author claim.

PRIOR-FINDING REASSESSMENT. Both prior audits (FRESH-SOURCE-AUDIT-A/B, actual Opus 4.8) reviewed the OLD PROPOSED-READER/UNIT and raised NEEDS_FIX on ER03 (no terminal-path liveness recheck; silent malformed-line skip), ER04 (hardcoded 5.5-only gate vs the both-Opus rule), and ER08 (test_reject_no_actual_assistant_frames hitting assistant_models[0] IndexError on an empty tuple, predicting 19 pass + 1 error, with the empty-assistant branch otherwise unreachable). I independently re-derived each against the CORRECTED assembly and find them all FIXED: (ER08) the stream builder now emits the DRAFT-carrying nested/quoted frames only when the assistant set is non-empty (test line 129 guard), so the empty case reaches the selector and yields NO_ACTUAL_ASSISTANT_MODEL_FRAMES, and the init frame is type:system plus the result text is not an assistant frame, so the branch is genuinely exercised; (ER04) the selector takes an explicit allowed_models set (default historical 5.5-only, preserving the WRONG-MODEL-REJECTION precedent), the wrapper reads T.get('terminalReviewAllowedModels',['claude-opus-5-5']), the receipt always records the real exclusiveActualAssistantModel and never relabels 4.8 as 5.5, and mix/out-of-set STOPs; (ER03) the terminal branch now performs the same os.kill(pid,0) liveness probe without mutating PROCESS.json (degrading a live/missing process to effective exit None -> NON_ZERO_OR_MISSING_TERMINAL_EXIT) and counts malformed capture lines into capture_parse_errors, which the selector fails closed on (CAPTURE_PARSE_ERRORS). Also fixed: ER05 wording (receipt identityMatchRule = canonical-sorted-key-JSON-value-identity), ER06 write-order (TERMINAL-REVIEW.json written BEFORE TERMINAL-EXPORT.json, both exclusive-create, plus preservedRecordSha256Before pins), and the retained-set-absent default (require_retained_membership True -> RETAINED_SET_ABSENT). I preserve the prior dispositions as correct for the OLD proposal and record that the corrected assembly resolves them; I add no new substantive dissent.

UNIT PREDICTION (independently derived, not taken from author/policy metadata). I traced all 29 methods against the selector as written and against ROOT-UNIT-PROPOSAL's exact envelope: timeout/prlimit/bwrap --unshare-all, /usr ro, two 0444 source files at /input (candidate+test, plain-named, sha pins matching), the PUBLIC correction packet bind-mounted READ-ONLY at its exact absolute path /home/charl/.../terminal-reader-correction-packet (which equals the test's hardcoded PACKET constant), python3 -I -B /input/test_terminal_review_selection.py -v, all three real fixtures required present (STOP on missing; skips rejected). Because the packet is at the hardcoded path with B-WHOLE-OBJECTS.json, B-OUTPUT-SCHEMA.json and SINGLE-REVIEW-A.json present, B_PRESENT and A_PRESENT are True and the 5 real-fixture methods RUN, not skip. The 24 always-run derived/pure methods pass as traced (canonical typed-object selection over quoted/nested/text duplicates; each STOP branch reached; the both-Opus honest-identity EXPORT; the bounded receipt allowlist of 19 keys; canonical-serialization-not-raw-byte membership). The real-B objects validate against the real schema, differ only at findings[5].evidence (B-I6), the selector exports whichever whole object is carried on result.structured_output for BOTH alternatives (no vote, no assumption of which is canonical), and the schema-valid token-matching third variant STOPs on CANONICAL_OBJECT_NOT_IN_RETAINED (the real schema has no maxLength on evidence, so validate does not raise first). SINGLE-REVIEW-A is a single dict whose token ends -a- and differs from the B token. PREDICTED: all 29 PASS, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips, exit 0, stdout empty, stderr = 29 verbose method 'ok' lines + the standard separator + 'Ran 29 tests in <t>' + 'OK', and the 2 source + 17 public packet pins/modes/listings unchanged (the unit writes nothing; -B suppresses pyc). Conditional on jsonschema being importable from the ro /usr and on python3.14 running cleanly; any import/startup/timeout/crash is a STOP, not a result.

CHECKS OF EVERY AUTHOR CLAIM. (1) Frozen count 29 = 24 always-run + 5 real-fixture: CONFIRMED by enumeration; the policy table order matches my independent list. (2) selector-absence EXPECTED RED "every method errors": IMPRECISE — methods 1 (derived multiplicity, uses only the naive-walk helper), 25, 26 and 29 do not invoke _load_selector and would PASS (25/26/29 when the packet is present) even with the selector absent; only the selector-invoking methods would error. This does not affect the GREEN prediction (the selector IS present). (3) time/memory/bounded-walk: AGREE — fixtures are small, the naive-walk re-parses only fenced/brace strings and is bounded, jsonschema validation over the two ~28 KB real objects is trivial, well under the cpu=10/wall=20/as=512MiB/fsize=2MiB/core=0 limits. (4) 5.5-only default gate correct for the current actual-5.5 B/A subjects and reconciled by parameterization: AGREE. (5) exclusive-create + early-exit immutability of PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE records: AGREE (root remains responsible for external before/after verification). (6) diff is one mechanical hunk combining the two additive blocks relative to the current reader: CONFIRMED (@@ -1,9 +1,145 @@), additive only.

RESIDUALS / LABEL ITEMS (none block source correctness). A named liveness race remains (a process dying between the probe and the capture read) — a source-only gap, not a test claim. Wrapper-only behaviours (live-PID probe, malformed-line counting, exclusive writes, in-artifact record pins) are NOT unit-observed and must remain source-only; their outcomes are covered at the selector level via effective-exit None and capture_parse_errors>0. The proposal-only diff header labels a/b as run_source_task.py while the file is run_source_task_candidate.py and the policy says the diff is relative to CURRENT-READER.py — cosmetic, diff not applied. The historical author metadata self-reports 5.5 while its own process record shows actual 4.8; preserved honestly, never adopted or relabeled; neither author metadata object is a vote. The provider-envelope contract (uniqueness of result.structured_output; origin of B's second whole object) lives only in private capture and is named, not read or assumed.

CONCLUSION. The corrected source, unit, policy and mechanical diff are minimal, additive, fail-closed and well-scoped; the two substantive prior defects (ER08 fixture, ER04 model gate) and the ER03 liveness/parse items are verifiably fixed, and I predict a clean 29/29 GREEN with no skips under the proposed envelope. sourceReady and ordinaryUnitReady are recommended for EXACTLY ONE root-gated ordinary unit, as ONE vote; realExportReady is false always. B's two-object multiplicity STOP stays OPEN and no claim is made about which B object is the historical canonical identity. M-HASH and all 20 UTxO families, full finance/ACTUS/DeFi, PCD/recursion, private handoff, multi-parent composition and real Preprod remain OPEN; native authority 0.

assessments.evidence: Minimal and additive. The selector exports exactly result.structured_output on the single success result, with explicit refusal of assistant-text/partial/nested-tool/quoted-JSON fallback and no use of the recursive walk (candidate 67-94; docstring 4-12). Grounded independently in OFFICIAL-STRUCTURED-OUTPUTS.md:57 (validated data on the result message), :390 (success-without-structured_output must be treated as a failure), :381 (model-fallback retraction). No historical canonical identity is assumed; authority selection is separated from unique judgment and adoption.

Fails closed on missing/non-zero exit (step 3), zero/multiple result events (step 7), non-success/error result (step 8), and absent/non-dict structured_output (step 9). The former owner-questions are resolved: the terminal branch mirrors the live-PID probe without mutating PROCESS.json (114-117) and degrades to effective exit None, and malformed lines are counted (119-124) and STOP via CAPTURE_PARSE_ERRORS (step 5). The two public B whole objects parse to distinct values at findings[5].evidence (B-I6: the digit zero vs the six-character reverse-solidus-u-0-0-3-0 escape for code point U+0030) and are never conflated. RETAINED_SET_ABSENT when required (88); no splice/merge/convenient-vote; no text/partial fallback; no quoted-text fallback.

Only two new files, both exclusive-create (139,140) with a pre-existence guard (109) that refuses to overwrite; on EXPORT the review is written BEFORE the receipt so a receipt can never exist without its review; on STOP only the receipt is written. The branch exits before any existing-record write, so PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE remain immutable; preservedRecordSha256Before pins each at read time (131-137); a partial-write failure fails closed on re-run. External before/after verification of all preserved records, schema and source remains a root duty, stated not omitted.

A single pure top-level FunctionDef: select_terminal_structured_review references only json and jsonschema plus builtins, reads no files, opens no socket, mutates nothing, raises no exception for policy STOPs. The unit AST-parses the candidate, selects that one named FunctionDef, compiles a module of that node alone and execs it in a namespace of only json+jsonschema (test 99-108); it never imports or runs the whole module, the job/dispatch logic, or any private-file I/O; no cache/network/provider/native path.

All 29 methods (24 always-run + 5 real-fixture) trace to PASS against the candidate as written. The prior empty-assistant defect is fixed (guard at test line 129) and the branch is genuinely reached; branch-reachability for every STOP reason is covered; fixtures are clearly labeled DERIVED UNIT frames (not provider events, not Cardano data) and the compact UNIT schema stands in for the frozen schema, while the 5 real-fixture methods bind the real public B objects, the real frozen B schema and the single A review (F9 addressed).
